title: Pipeline design doc
verdict: The design doc fills in details on pages that already exist: the run time (02:00 UTC), the Billing API limit (100 requests per second) and how files are deleted. It also answers the open question from the kickoff and adds a page for the Payments team.
lesson: Most of an ingest is updating, not creating. The open question on the Billing API page is closed here, by the source that answered it.
